risks.title: Unfavorable global economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions 'changes in general economic, business, political and regulatory conditions' and 'weaker global economic conditions' as causes of the sales decline. The impact on sales is significant (-3.7% overall for Engineered Materials, -11.1% for Acetyl Chain).

risks.title: Volatility in raw material and energy prices
risks.score_rationale: The document cites 'volatility or changes in the price and availability of raw materials and energy' and lists several key raw materials (ethylene, methanol, natural gas, carbon monoxide, wood pulp, PA66). The ability to pass through these costs is limited, affecting margins.

risks.title: Intensified competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions 'increased price competition' and 'competitive market dynamics' as causes of price declines of -1% for Engineered Materials and -6% for Acetyl Chain. This directly affects profitability.

risks.title: Risks related to the integration of the Mobility Materials acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The risk is clearly stated: 'possibility that we will not be able to realize the anticipated benefits of the Mobility Materials business... including synergies and growth opportunities'. The acquisition is recent and its success is not guaranteed.

risks.title: Indebtedness and ability to raise capital
risks.score_rationale: The level of indebtedness is mentioned as a risk ('our level of indebtedness') that 'could diminish our ability to raise additional capital', affecting financial flexibility and increasing interest costs. The company has paused share buybacks and cut dividends by 95%.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly cites 'geopolitical conditions', 'acts of war or conflict (such as the Russia-Ukraine conflict or conflicts in the Middle East)' and 'supply chain disruptions' as potential causes of operational interruptions.

risks.title: Litigation and regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions 'potential liability resulting from pending or future claims or litigation, including investigations or enforcement actions, or from changes in the laws, regulations or policies'. This risk is recurring and may result in significant costs.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
